estimates.assumptions: Plain water contributes 0g carbohydrates and 0g fiber.
380g full-fat canned coconut milk (standard ~3g carbs/100g, negligible fiber).

1/2 tsp ground nutmeg (modest seasoning amount, ~2g total).
1/4 tsp ground allspice (modest seasoning amount, ~1g total).
1/2 cup (approx. 150g) sweetened condensed milk (standard ~37g carbs/100g, negligible fiber).
